note: What a server sends to say a unit is casting a spell. The header names the unit casting, as the casting inside does.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: A client uses it only to decide whether the caster's position can be brought in line for this cast.

bits.name: endCharge
bits.note: Set where the cast ends a charge: a client drops the message unless the caster is charging that same spell. Clear lets a client charge a spell that charges, sending SpellCharge as it does.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The name this casting is stated against. One of its values is observed on a unit that a Replication payload names with the same value.
